Get-ChildItem -Path $env:USERPROFILE -Recurse -Filter "dataforge-1.4.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName, Length, LastWriteTime

Get-PSDrive -PSProvider FileSystem | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem -Path $_.Root -Recurse -Filter "dataforge-1.4.0-linux-x86_64.tar.gz" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } | Select-Object FullName
